proposals.title: Prefer places famous for what's underneath
proposals.change: Research and the planner favour places whose underground is the famous part (underground cities, catacombs, cisterns, under-river metros, deepest stations, officially public bunkers) over landmarks whose underground is only foundations and utilities. Research applies it when sourcing; no code change.
proposals.expectedEffect: more Shorts from topics with 1M+ breakout references
proposals.risk: fewer famous-skyline landmarks; sourcing deep layers is harder

proposals.title: Let the dive kit's depth meter and stack go to kilometres
proposals.change: The Kola Superdeep Borehole topic (top of the feed, score 9.71) runs 0 to 12,262 m with layers at 3, 6, 7, 11.9 and 12.3 km. Check that the depth meter in remotion/src/dive formats km (12.3 km / 40,230 ft, converted in code) and that the dive's camera spacing between layers is by layer order, not linear depth, so a 3 km gap and a 20 m gap both take one beat. Add the piece additively if missing (routine.md 3c lets the video run do it too).
proposals.expectedEffect: The highest-demand topic we have (deepest-hole Shorts at 6-27M) renders on the first try instead of failing QA on the meter.
